Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.18

  • Added install-time safeguards that create the installed doc/ directory before vignette indexing, without keeping inst/doc in the editable source tree. This avoids the interactive prompt about deleting inst/doc while preventing vignette-installation failures on Windows/R 4.6.
  • Removed unused vignettes/logo.png and vignettes/logo.svg files; pkgdown now uses the package logo only through the page header.
  • Kept the pkgdown logo display restricted to individual article headers; index pages and the navbar do not display the package logo.
  • No statistical computations changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.16

  • Removed the manually maintained inst/doc placeholder so development builds no longer ask whether inst/doc should be deleted. The vignette documentation should be generated by R during package build rather than stored manually in the editable source.
  • Removed manual logo chunks from the four vignettes so the logo appears only once in pkgdown article pages, in the article title/header generated by pkgdown.
  • Removed the manual README logo image to avoid an oversized duplicate logo on the pkgdown home page.
  • Updated pkgdown/extra.css to hide the automatic logo on article-index and other index pages while keeping it in individual article page headers.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.15

  • Added a small inst/doc/.keep file so the installed package always has a doc/ directory available while R installs vignette indices on Windows/R-devel.
  • This is a packaging/install robustness fix only; no statistical computations or exported functions were changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.14

  • Renames the pkgdown navbar entry from New to News.
  • Hides the automatic navbar logo in the pkgdown site so the package logo appears only once at the beginning of the README and vignette content.
  • No statistical computations were changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.13

  • Adopts the selected sober bell-curve hex logo as the package logo.
  • Replaces the logo assets in man/figures/ and vignettes/ with the selected design, including PNG and SVG versions.
  • No statistical computations were changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.12

  • Adds a hexagonal package logo in R package style and includes it in the README and vignettes.
  • Adds accessible aria-label attributes to navbar icons in _pkgdown.yml.
  • Documents that the remaining Quarto TMPDIR message is external to the package when R CMD check reports 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 notes.
  • No statistical computations were changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.11

  • Updated the pkgdown site theme to use the Bootswatch Flatly visual style, following the look requested for the online documentation and vignettes.
  • Rewrote the pkgdown navbar explicitly with Home, Reference, Vignettes, New, and GitHub entries to avoid malformed adjacent navbar labels.
  • Added pkgdown/extra.css with small visual refinements for the pkgdown site.
  • No statistical computations were changed.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.10

  • Reformats public reference sections so APA-style entries appear as plain paragraphs rather than bulleted lists in roxygen help, generated Rd pages, the PDF manual, README, and vignettes.
  • No changes to statistical computations.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.9

  • Refines the pkgdown home-page wording so the introductory paragraph links René Gempp directly to https://gempp.cl and omits institutional affiliation from that sentence.
  • Adds an explicit Author section to the package-level help page with René Gempp’s email and website.
  • Revises the pkgdown navbar so Vignettes is a dropdown linking directly to the four vignette pages and New links directly to the NEWS page.
  • Clarifies that the remaining Quarto TMPDIR message observed after devtools::check() is an external devtools/Quarto command-detection message, not a package check failure when the summary reports 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 notes.
  • No changes to statistical computations.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.8

  • Updates RoxygenNote to 8.0.0 to match the installed roxygen2 version used during documentation generation.
  • Removes the manually maintained top-level INDEX file. Modern R builds the package help index during installation, and keeping a static INDEX can make R CMD build report that the index is not up to date.
  • No changes to statistical computations.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.7

  • Updates package-level documentation to the current roxygen2 convention by documenting the special _PACKAGE sentinel instead of using the deprecated @docType package tag.
  • Keeps the package-level help topic and aliases available while avoiding the roxygen2 deprecation message during devtools::document().
  • No changes to statistical computations.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.6

  • Replaced the former single AUC-to-r helper with an explicit AUC conversion family: auc_to_rank_biserial(), auc_to_d_equal_variance(), d_to_point_biserial(), and auc_to_point_biserial().
  • Retained auc_to_r() as a backward-compatible alias for auc_to_point_biserial(auc, base_rate = .50), but marked it as internal in the pkgdown reference index.
  • Updated documentation and examples to distinguish dominance summaries, equal-variance binormal d conversions, and base-rate-sensitive point-biserial conversions.
  • Added references to Hanley and McNeil (1982), Rice and Harris (2005), Kerby (2014), and Salgado (2018).

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.5

  • Adds package-level help documentation so the package has a stable landing help topic.
  • Adds a top-level INDEX file to improve package help indexing in installed packages.
  • Removes references to the internal utility-analysis review draft from public documentation.
  • Reformats references in help pages, the PDF manual, README, and vignettes as list-style APA entries.
  • Updates pkgdown labels so Articles appears as Vignettes and Changelog appears as New.
  • Updates the README/pkgdown home page introduction and author metadata with https://gempp.cl.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.4

  • Fix pkgdown reference index by adding inflation_adjusted_rate() to _pkgdown.yml.
  • No changes to statistical computations. This release only corrects site-building metadata.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.3

  • Fixes the remaining R CMD check test failure by making the Thomas-Owen-Gunst equal-cutoff test robust to small numerical integration differences.
  • In tr_multivariate_equal_cutoff(), stores the raw computed joint selection ratio as computed_joint_selection_ratio, reports the target design value as joint_selection_ratio, and retains joint_selection_error for diagnostics.
  • Removes the unused utils import.
  • Adds _pkgdown.yml to .Rbuildignore so the pkgdown configuration remains in the development repository but is not included in the built package.
  • Wraps long roxygen example comments to avoid Rd line-width notes.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.2

  • Fixed roxygen2 markdown parsing errors in conversions.R by replacing ambiguous inline code beginning with r = with Rd math markup.
  • Marked NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd as roxygen2-generated so devtools::document() can overwrite them cleanly.
  • Added an RStudio project file to the editable source folder.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.1

  • Fixes vignette installation failure in continuous-monetary-utility-bcg-boudreau-sturman.Rmd by replacing the obsolete focal_predictors call with the preferred added_predictors argument.
  • Adds focal_predictors as a backward-compatible optional alias in incremental_validity(): when supplied, it is interpreted as the expanded predictor set and converted internally to setdiff(focal_predictors, baseline_predictors).

personnelSelectionUtility 0.5.0

  • Added explicit literature references to function help pages and examples.
  • Added reference comments to all minimal examples so users can see which papers motivate each computation.
  • Expanded substantive examples for core functions with citations to Taylor and Russell (1939), Thomas, Owen, and Gunst (1977), Naylor and Shine (1965), Brogden (1946, 1949), Cronbach and Gleser (1965), Boudreau (1983, 1991), Sturman (2001), and Ock and Oswald (2018), as applicable.
  • Expanded vignettes with source-based guidance, recommended analysis workflows, and cautionary notes on assumptions, baselines, SDy estimation, uncertainty, and compensatory versus multiple-hurdle design.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.4.0

  • Adds argument_glossary() to document the package’s public argument names and their correspondence with the notation used in utility-analysis literature.
  • Reviews argument names for consistency. Preferred names now include n_applicants, n_by_period, cost_by_period, and range_restriction_ratio; legacy aliases applicant_n, n_t, cost_t, and u remain accepted for backward compatibility.
  • Expands roxygen documentation with at least one executable minimal example for every exported function.
  • Adds richer applied examples for central functions: tr_classic(), tr_solve(), tr_multivariate(), tr_multivariate_equal_cutoff(), naylor_shine(), bcg_utility(), shp_utility(), boudreau_utility(), restricted_canonical_validity(), incremental_validity(), compensatory_selection(), multiple_hurdle_selection_staged(), compare_selection_systems_staged(), utility_monte_carlo(), sensitivity_grid(), and break_even_validity().
  • Adds four didactic vignettes: utility-analysis-taxonomy, taylor-russell-and-thomas-owen-gunst, continuous-monetary-utility-bcg-boudreau-sturman, and compensatory-vs-multiple-hurdle-simulation.
  • Adds a pkgdown site configuration with reference sections and articles, targeting https://rgempp.github.io/personnel-selection-utility/.
  • Updates author metadata, citation, README, tests, and manual pages for a more operational package workflow.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.3.0

  • Builds on the previous 0.2.0 API rather than replacing it.
  • Adds tr_multivariate_equal_cutoff() to reproduce Thomas-Owen-Gunst-style equal-cutoff tables from a target joint selection ratio.
  • Adds tr_binomial_success_probability() for finite-sample success probabilities after a Taylor-Russell calculation.
  • Aligns tr_solve() more closely with TaylorRussell::TR() by using a non-negative validity interval by default and handling PPV values that do not exceed the base rate defensively.
  • Adds staged multiple-hurdle simulation through multiple_hurdle_selection_staged() and compare_selection_systems_staged(), allowing each stage to be a composite of predictors.
  • Adds selection_utility_from_z() for Ock-Oswald-style utility calculations from expected criterion performance.
  • Adds diagnostic and SDy helpers from the Holling-oriented source functions: coefficient_of_determination(), forecasting_efficiency(), sdy_cost_accounting(), sdy_crepid(), correct_r_direct_range_restriction(), and utility_regression_diagnostics().
  • Extends boudreau_utility() with contribution_margin and variable_value_convention to make the (1 + V) versus (1 - V) interpretation explicit.
  • Updates README, vignette, mapping file, tests, and manual pages for the expanded 0.3.0 API.

personnelSelectionUtility 0.2.0

  • Adds the Thomas-Owen-Gunst multivariate Taylor-Russell model via tr_multivariate() using mvtnorm::pmvnorm().
  • Adds flexible univariate Taylor-Russell solving via tr_solve().
  • Adds a model taxonomy aligned with criterion scale and selection structure.
  • Adds Sturman-style restricted canonical validity and incremental-validity utilities.
  • Adds simulation helpers to compare compensatory and multiple-hurdle selection systems.
  • Adds Boudreau-style discounted utility, probation-period adjustment helpers, multi-attribute utility, Pareto frontiers, adverse-impact summaries, and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
  • Harmonizes argument names: validity, selection_ratio, base_rate, sdy, n_selected, tenure, and cost.
